visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap and black long-sleeved shirt stands in a brightly lit office studio. Behind him is a whiteboard with 'momax' and dates written on it. He holds a yellow drumstick over a colorful toy drum placed on a chair, maintaining a focused expression. (2) The man strikes the toy drum with precision at a specific moment. He then looks at the camera with a satisfied smile. A white text overlay at the top reads 'Whitney Houston Challenge'. (3) A second man, dressed in a white t-shirt and black open jacket, attempts the same challenge. He hits the drum but misses the rhythm, leading him to laugh and walk away as the camera follows his movement. (4) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white shirt under a patterned knit vest, tries the challenge. She successfully hits the drum, then leans over laughing uncontrollably with her mouth wide open. (5) A fourth man with glasses and a grey hoodie takes his turn. After hitting the drum, he celebrates enthusiastically with a fist pump and a wide grin. (6) A fifth man with dyed pink hair and a black jacket attempts the drum hit. Afterward, the first man joins him, and they both face the camera to speak directly to the audience, showcasing a small round object. Text overlays regarding product features appear sequentially. (7) The video cuts to a final graphic screen featuring a product logo, QR code, and detailed sales information on a black background.
